The decisive mistake was at step 3. The WomenInComputerScienceHistory_Expert assumed the 24% figure corresponded to "today" (2022) and computed 2022 − 1995 = 27 years. The search results at step 2 show a chart on the Girls Who Code About Us page with three data points: 37% (1995), 24% (2017), and 22% (2022). The 37% → 24% change therefore took 2017 − 1995 = 22 years, which matches the correct answer. The later steps (4–8) only re-checked and endorsed the wrong 2022 endpoint.
